title: The Voice on the Phone Sounded Exactly Like My Brother
script: Narrator: [thoughtful] Last week, my phone rang from an unfamiliar number, and the voice on the other end was, unmistakably, my younger brother's, panic and all.
Narrator: He claimed he'd been in an accident, that his phone was damaged, and that he urgently needed money transferred before the hospital would treat him.
Narrator: [carefully] Every inflection matched him perfectly, the way he stumbles slightly over certain words when he's genuinely upset, details I couldn't imagine anyone faking convincingly.
Narrator: My hands were already reaching for my banking app before some small, stubborn part of my brain insisted on pausing for just one moment.
Narrator: [reflective] I remembered an article I'd skimmed months earlier about voices being cloned from mere seconds of audio, pulled from something as ordinary as a public video.
Narrator: So instead of transferring anything, I hung up and called my brother's actual number, the one saved in my phone for years, not the one that had just called me.
Narrator: [honestly] He answered from his couch, utterly confused, having no idea any of this was happening, watching television exactly where he was supposed to be.
Narrator: It shook me more than I expected. If I hadn't paused, if that stubborn instinct had lost that particular argument, I'd have sent money to a stranger wearing my brother's voice.
Narrator: [gently] What disturbs me most isn't the technology itself, but how effortlessly it exploits something as intimate as recognizing someone you love by sound alone.
Narrator: Now our whole family has agreed on a private question, something only we would know, to ask whenever a call like that arrives unexpectedly.
Narrator: [calmly] It feels almost absurd, verifying my own brother like he's a stranger at the door, yet apparently that's simply where things stand now.
Narrator: I've told this story to nearly everyone I know since, partly as a warning, partly because saying it aloud still helps me process how close I came.
Narrator: [encouraging] My brother, for his part, finds the whole ordeal hilarious, though he's agreed to the secret question without a single objection.

quiz.question: What did the caller claim had happened to the narrator's brother?
options: He lost his job
He was traveling abroad
He forgot his wallet
He'd been in an accident and urgently needed money for hospital treatment
quiz.explanation: The caller claimed her brother had been in an accident and needed money transferred urgently before the hospital would treat him.

quiz.question: What made the narrator pause before transferring money?
options: Her phone battery died
She remembered an article about voices being cloned from seconds of audio
A friend called her at the same time
The caller asked for too much money
quiz.explanation: She remembered an article about voices being cloned from mere seconds of audio, pulled from something like a public video.

quiz.question: What did she do instead of transferring the money?
options: She called the police immediately
She sent a smaller amount instead
She ignored the call completely
She hung up and called her brother's actual saved number
quiz.explanation: She hung up and called her brother's actual number saved in her phone, not the number that had just called her.

quiz.question: Where was her brother when she actually reached him?
options: In a hospital
Traveling in another country
On his couch, watching television, with no idea what was happening
At work in a meeting
quiz.explanation: He answered from his couch, confused, watching television exactly where he was supposed to be.

quiz.question: What has the whole family agreed on since the incident?
options: To stop answering unknown calls entirely
To change all their phone numbers
To never discuss money over the phone again
A private question only they would know, to ask during suspicious calls
quiz.explanation: The family agreed on a private question, something only they would know, to ask whenever a suspicious call arrives.

quiz.question: What memory made the narrator pause before transferring money?
options: An article had explained that public audio can train voice clones.
Our caller has strong feelings on this
Whether facial recognition was necessary for attendance at all.
They documented deletion periods and restricted access to stored copies.
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: An article had explained that public audio can train voice clones.

quiz.question: How did the narrator verify whether the emergency was genuine?
options: That's a sobering way to reach clarity
He ended the call and rang his brother's saved number.
They learned their options, storage period, and review route.
More test users completed the application.
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: He ended the call and rang his brother's saved number.

quiz.question: Where was the real brother during the supposed accident?
options: He was safely at home watching television.
A few assumed I'd become less committed, which stung initially
Her case was not campaign material without her consent.
Detailed notice cannot justify collecting data without a purpose.
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: He was safely at home watching television.

quiz.question: What safeguard does the family adopt after the attempted fraud?
options: A shared rule protects those who'd never dare raise the issue alone
A machine's output carried more authority than a student's account.
Unexpected callers must answer a private family question.
Users gained plain-language options for download, correction, and deletion.
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: Unexpected callers must answer a private family question.

quiz.question: Why was the cloned voice especially effective?
options: I hope someone finally silences their notifications after we finish talking tonight
It exploited intimate trust in a loved one's familiar speech.
Human review, limited data, and accessible correction must be built in.
The team chose not to collect several unnecessary data points.
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: It exploited intimate trust in a loved one's familiar speech.
